dialogues.speaker: Hajjan
dialogues.text: The ecological issues in this area require further observation and analysis...

dialogues.speaker: Fateh
dialogues.text: You scholars and your big words... You know what would really impress me? Fixing the humidity in this forest...

dialogues.speaker: Fateh
dialogues.text: My whole family's having a hard time with this climate... Seriously, all my old injuries are acting up.
